scope: Every other CVE that OSV.dev advisories name for a package in npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, RubyGems, Packagist or NuGet: published more than 30 days ago, not in CISA KEV, not listed as exploited and not woken up, scored by the same model. They have no detail shard; rows keep no chip lists and titles of at most 80 characters. Only advisory IDs, package names and version ranges are kept.
